title: "code_buy&hold_momentum"

library(readr)
library(dplyr)



########## krok 1 ##################
# 1) wczytaj returns, musi być pobrany plik "returns.csv" z repozytorium
```{r}
returns <- read_csv("returns.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```


# 2) Date jako data + sort
```{r}
returns <- returns %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  arrange(Date)
```


# 3) policz miesięczny zwrot "rynku" jako equal-weighted średnia zwrotów spółek

```{r}
ret_mat <- returns %>% select(-Date)


r_mkt <- rowMeans(ret_mat, na.rm = TRUE)


df1 <- tibble(
  Date = returns$Date,
  r_mkt = r_mkt
)

```


# 4) szybkie kontrole
```{r}
df1 %>% summarise(
  start = min(Date),
  end = max(Date),
  n_months = n(),
  any_na = any(is.na(r_mkt))
)
```


########### krok 2 ###########
```{r}
library(dplyr)


df2 <- df1 %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1) syntetyczna cena rynku (start = 1)
    P = cumprod(1 + r_mkt),
    
    
    # 2) momentum 12–1
    # M_t = P_{t-1} / P_{t-12} - 1
    M = lag(P, 1) / lag(P, 12) - 1,
    
    
    # 3) decyzja inwestycyjna
    pos = if_else(M > 0, 1, 0)
  )


df2 %>%
  select(Date, r_mkt, P, M, pos) %>%
  head(15)

```


##### krok 3 ######
```{r}
df3 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    r_bh = r_mkt,
    r_mom = pos * r_mkt
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(M)) # wspólny okres porównania

df3 %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(Date),
    end = max(Date),
    n_months = n(),
    share_in_market = mean(pos)
  )
```



###### krok 4 ######
```{r}
library(dplyr)


df4 <- df3 %>%
  mutate(
    equity_bh = cumprod(1 + r_bh),
    equity_mom = cumprod(1 + r_mom)
  )

df4 %>%
  select(Date, equity_bh, equity_mom) %>%
  head(10)
```



###### krok 5 #####
# =========================
# Funkcje pomocnicze
# =========================
```{r}
cagr <- function(r) {
  n <- length(r)
  (prod(1 + r))^(12 / n) - 1
}


ann_vol <- function(r) {
  sd(r) * sqrt(12)
}


sharpe <- function(r) {
  mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(12)
}


max_dd <- function(r) {
  equity <- cumprod(1 + r)
  peak <- cummax(equity)
  dd <- equity / peak - 1
  min(dd)
}

```



# =========================
# Liczenie metryk
# =========================
```{r}
metrics <- tibble(
  strategy = c("Buy & Hold", "Momentum 12–1"),
  annual_return = c(
    cagr(df3$r_bh),
    cagr(df3$r_mom)
  ),
  annual_volatility = c(
    ann_vol(df3$r_bh),
    ann_vol(df3$r_mom)
  ),
  sharpe_ratio = c(
    sharpe(df3$r_bh),
    sharpe(df3$r_mom)
  ),
  max_drawdown = c(
    max_dd(df3$r_bh),
    max_dd(df3$r_mom)
  )
)


metrics
```


######## krok 6 #####
```{r}
t_test <- t.test(
  df3$r_mom,
  df3$r_bh,
  paired = TRUE
)


t_test
```



###### wykresy ######
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)


df_plot <- df4 %>%
  select(Date, equity_bh, equity_mom) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(equity_bh, equity_mom),
    names_to = "strategy",
    values_to = "equity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    strategy = recode(
      strategy,
      equity_bh = "Buy & Hold",
      equity_mom = "Momentum 12–1"
    )
  )


```


```{r}
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Date, y = equity, linetype = strategy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Krzywe kapitału: Buy & Hold vs Momentum 12–1",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Kapitał (start = 1)",
    linetype = "Strategia"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

y_min <- min(df_plot$equity, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(df_plot$equity, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min
```


```{r}


ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Date, y = equity, color = strategy, linetype = strategy)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Buy & Hold" = "blue",
    "Momentum 12–1" = "forestgreen"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Equity curves: Buy & Hold vs Momentum 12–1",
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Kapitał"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

```
